# Get MARFIS data
```{r get_MARFIS_data}
# This is where we store the MARFIS pulls:
# R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/Old pulls/marfis_pull.Rdata

# This function checks to see when the last pull was and asks if you'd like to
# update the pull. It then loads the MARFIS data without changing anything.
# If you decide to do a new MARFIS pull and there are new additions to the db
# that were not in the last pull, you will be prompted to make changes to the
# Master Rivername Database. This is located on the R drive here:'
# R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/MASTER_RIVERNAME_DATABASE.csv
#source(here("other_functions", "pull_marfis_data.R"))

# You don't always have to pull the MARFIS data when working with it, that just
# updates the copy of the data we have to the most up to date version. If you 
# want to load MARFIS data that already exist, just load it from here:
load("R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/Old pulls/marfis_pull.Rdata")

```

# marfis_error_cleaner
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# The function we use to clean the data is currently located here:

# "R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/MARFIS.error.cleaner.R"

# This function contains data which CANNOT be stored on the unit github page
# because it contains information that ostensibly could be used to glean how
# much someone is earning, so we store it on the R drive, which seems a bit
# extra. However, this is the rule (for now)
source("R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/MARFIS_error_cleaner.R")

df <- marfis_error_cleaner(
  catch = catch,
  years = "all",
  convert_to_kgs = TRUE,
  tidy_data = TRUE,
  correct_eel_pot = TRUE,
  unknown_rivers_are_na = TRUE,
  unknown_gear_are_na = TRUE
  )
```

# Data exploration
```{r}
# I use this function to quickly look at pertinent log data from the catch df
source(here("other_functions", "fwl.R"))

# This function plots landings for the licence
source(here("other_functions", "plot_licence.R"))
```

```{r}

# Get number of observations
df |> 
  filter(RIVERNAME_CLEANED == "TUSKET") |> 
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2024, 2025)) |> 
  mutate(YEAR = as.factor(YEAR)) |>
  group_by(YEAR, LICENCE_ID) |> 
  summarise(TOTAL = sum(FV_WEIGHT)) |> 
  count() -> counts

df |> 
  filter(RIVERNAME_CLEANED == "TUSKET") |> 
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2024, 2025)) |> 
  mutate(YEAR = as.factor(YEAR)) |>
  group_by(YEAR, LICENCE_ID) |> 
  summarise(TOTAL = sum(FV_WEIGHT)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = TOTAL, fill = YEAR)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  #geom_jitter() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(
    data = counts,
    aes(x = YEAR, y = 3.5e4, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    n.breaks = 10,
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reported landings for Tusket",
    x = "",
    y = "Total landings (kg)",
    fill = "Year"
    )
```
